career_ladder.note: Executive engineering hierarchy within Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (MSETCL / Mahatransco), the state-owned transmission utility managing over 50,000 circuit km of high-voltage transmission lines, 400kV/220kV/132kV substations, and the State Load Dispatch Centre (SLDC) at Kalwa. Promotion from Assistant Engineer up to Executive Director is governed by MSETCL Employees' Service Regulations based on Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) reviews, seniority-cum-merit, and departmental qualifications.

exam_scheme.note: Conducted as an online Computer Based Test (CBT) by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) on behalf of MSETCL. The test consists of 130 objective multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 150 marks over 120 minutes. Negative marking is applicable at 0.25 (1/4th) of the marks assigned to each specific question for incorrect answers. There is no personal interview for Assistant Engineer posts; final merit ranking and selection are determined solely by CBT performance followed by document verification.

financial_package.note: MSETCL is an unbundled state power transmission utility operating under MSEB Holding Company Ltd., wholly owned by the Government of Maharashtra. Pay scales are established under tripartite utility wage agreements, strictly independent of Central 7th CPC structures.
